subject: Integrator Week 0 — Hands-on lab & onboarding logistics
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Kiran Malhotra <kiran@northforge.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integrator Week 0 — Hands-on lab & onboarding logistics

Hi Kiran —

Thanks for agreeing to run a Week 0 onboarding for the NorthForge SI team for deal NF-7312. The objective is to get your engineers hands-on with our sandbox, validate integration patterns for the adaptor, and confirm operational guards (keys, rate limits, and KV cache behavior) before the formal enablement week.

Proposed items for Week 0 (2–3 half-day sessions):
- Day 1 (morning): sandbox access + authentication walkthrough (SSO/KMS)
- Day 1 (afternoon): quickstart lab — run a sample integration and observe latency/cost telemetry
- Day 2: deep-dive on batching/caching patterns and troubleshooting KV cache warm-up

Attachments: Week0-Lab-Guide.pdf (8 pages) — lab steps, prerequisites, and checklists.

Can you confirm:
1) preferred dates (we have availability Mar 10–12 or Mar 16–18)
2) how many NorthForge engineers will attend and their timezones
3) whether you need SOC2 / compliance artifacts shared before the sessions

If those dates work I’ll provision sandbox creds and push the MAP draft to the Drive link below.

Drive link for mutual action plan and materials: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cMAP-NF-7312

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—Sean Gallagher
Director, Solutions Alliances
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Week0-Lab-Guide.pdf (8 pages)]
From: Kiran Malhotra <kiran@northforge.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@northforge.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integrator Week 0 — Hands-on lab & onboarding logistics

Thanks Sean — this looks good.

We can do Mar 10–12, prefer mornings (ET) for our Mumbai and Boston engineers. Expected attendees: 4 engineers + 1 PS lead (Elena Ruiz cc’d).

A couple of quick questions:
- Prereqs: do attendees need any specific HW or client versions installed, or can we run everything from their laptops?
- SOC2 / compliance: we need a copy of your SOC2 report and a short dataflow diagram to share with our security team before granting any sandbox access.
- SSO/SCIM: do you support SAML SSO for sandbox users, or will it be local accounts initially?

I’ll confirm exact attendee names by EOD tomorrow and want to get a Slack channel set up between our PS and your Enablement team.

Best,
Kiran
Principal Technical Lead — Integrations
NorthForge Professional Services
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Kiran Malhotra <kiran@northforge.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integrator Week 0 — Hands-on lab & onboarding logistics

Hi Kiran —

Short answers:
- Labs run from laptops; we provide containerized environments and a lightweight CLI that works on macOS/Linux/Windows WSL. No special GPUs required for Week 0.
- SOC2: attaching an internal quick checklist and I’ll loop Security to share the formal SOC2 report + dataflow diagram.
- SSO: we can do SAML-based SSO for your team; initial sandbox access can be created as local accounts and later linked to SSO if you prefer.

I’ve attached the SI-Quickstart-Checklist.docx — it lists client versions, required ports, and the small OS-level tweaks we recommend. Action items I’ll own:
1) Provision sandbox accounts for up to 8 users (placeholder emails ok)
2) Open a formal SOC2 request with Security and share files via a protected Drive link
3) Schedule a 30m dry-run for the lab leads on Mar 9 (optional)

Sean / Ben — if you want the MAP filled with milestone owners before Kiran confirms attendees, I can seed it today.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Partner Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SI-Quickstart-Checklist.docx (2 pages)]
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Kiran Malhotra <kiran@northforge.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integrator Week 0 — Hands-on lab & onboarding logistics

Perfect — let’s tentatively lock: Mar 10 (09:00–12:00 ET) and Mar 11 (09:00–12:00 ET). We’ll keep Mar 12 as a buffer for follow-up.

Camila will provision the sandbox and share local creds by Mar 5. Security will push SOC2 and a redacted dataflow diagram to the Drive link; I’ve asked for a short note about retention and logs specifically (your question on audit evidence).

I uploaded a MAP draft (MAP-NF-7312.docx) to the Drive link. Please review owner and acceptance criteria for the Week 0 tasks and comment inline. If that looks good I’ll convert it to a mutual action plan record in HubSpot and assign to our Enablement queue.

Next steps for Kiran / NorthForge:
- Share attendee names & timezones by Tue end-of-day (Mar 2)
- Confirm Slack workspace/channel for direct comms
- Provide any procurement contacts if we need an NDA/PO in place for access (unlikely for sandbox but good to know)

Thanks all — leaning on Ben for scheduling invites and for the Zoom/recording setup.

—Sean
[Attachment: MAP-NF-7312.docx (1 page)]
From: Kiran Malhotra <kiran@northforge.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@northforge.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integrator Week 0 — Hands-on lab & onboarding logistics

Thanks — confirmed. We’ll send the attendee list (4 engineers + 1 PS lead) by end of day. Timezones are Boston (ET) and Mumbai (IST) — mornings ET work for us.

Elena will create the Slack channel and invite your enablement alias (enablement@northforge.com) — please share the preferred contact.

Procurement note: no NDA or PO needed for sandbox. We will, however, want the SOC2 / dataflow artefacts before full access — Elena will chase that on our side too.

Look forward to the dry-run on Mar 9 if you confirm.

Regards,
Kiran
Principal Technical Lead — Integrations
NorthForge Professional Services
